what.statement: Dedicated proxy ports let an internet gateway or SD-WAN device forward user traffic to a port number assigned to the organization. It is an additional subscription service, recommended only when the gateway cannot provide GRE or IPSec tunnels, and the ports are tied to locations you designate.

quotes: In this model, your internet gateway or SD-WAN device forwards user traffic to a specific port number assigned to your organization.
This is an additional subscription service available from Zscaler, and is only recommended when your gateway device is not capable of providing GRE or IPSec tunnels.
The ports are tied to locations you have designated.

authentication.statement: Users on a dedicated proxy port must authenticate, because anyone can send traffic to the port. Remote users need a PAC file to reach proxy ports; deploying Zscaler Client Connector is the more robust method.

quotes: Because anyone can send traffic to a dedicated proxy port, Zscaler requires that your users authenticate to prevent misuse of the system.
A more robust method for remote users is to deploy Zscaler Client Connector to your remote stations.

configuration.statement: Ports are configured on the Location Management page by adding the assigned ports and selecting Enforce authentication. Zscaler recommends enabling Surrogate IP on proxy ports and for remote users.

quotes: Configuration of dedicated proxy ports is handled on the Location Management page of the ZIA Admin Portal.
Zscaler recommends enabling Surrogate IP on proxy ports and for remote users.

required-settings.statement: The required location settings for a proxy port are NAT disabled, Surrogate IP enabled and authentication at the location enabled.

quotes: NAT Disable Surrogate IP Enable Authentication at location Enable
